lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in organized horizontal rows; the anterior section exhibits a high density of smaller, tightly packed clusters, while the posterior section shows larger, more widely spaced nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a defined grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features running along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated, low-luminance silhouette is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
